title: When Frog Eyes Are Like Fingerprints - Nautilus
gist: A study in Herpetozoa reports that eye patterns of egg-eating spiny-backed frogs can reliably identify individuals without capture, acting like fingerprints. This could replace stressful toe-clipping for DNA sampling, especially harmful to tree frogs.
